मौञ्ज मौञ्ज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मुञ्ज), made
of Muñja grass or its fibres; resembling Muñja grass;
(अस्), m. a blade of Muñja grass; (ई), f., scil. मे-
खला, a Brāhman's girdle or cord made of a triple
string of Muñja grass; any girdle.
—मौञ्जी-तृणा-
ख्य (˚ण-आख्˚), अस्, m. Muñja grass.
—मौञ्जी-
धर, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing or carrying Muñja grass.
—मौञ्जी-निबन्धन, अम्, n. the binding on of
the girdle of Muñja grass, ligation of the sacrificial
cord (Manu

).
—मौञ्जी-पत्त्रा, f. Eleusine
Indica.
—मौञ्जी-बन्धन, अम्, n. the ligation or
binding on of the Muñja grass girdle, investiture
with the sacred thread, (in Manu 11. 169. shortened
on account of the metre to मौञ्जि-बन्धन.)
—मौञ्जीबन्धन-चिह्नित, अस्, आ, अम्, distin-
guished by the ligation of the Muñja zone (Manu

मौञ्जक, अस्, m. a blade of Muñja grass; (also
read मुञ्जक.)

मौञ्जवत, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. coming from the
mountain Muñja-vat; (also read मौजवत, q. v.)
मौञ्जायनीय, अस्, m. a king of the Mauñjāyanas.
मौञ्जीय, अस्, आ, अम्, made of Muñja grass.
